mapper.select: SELECT opt.TARGET_ID as targetId , mst.VALUATION, DATE_FORMAT(mst.VAL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') as valDate ,mst.FINPROD_ID2,DATE_FORMAT(mst.PUBLISH_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') as publishDate FROM MST_VAL_OP mst LEFT JOIN FIN_RATE_INFO fin ON fin.FINPROD_ID=mst.FINPROD_ID2 AND fin.BENCHMARK_TYPE = #{BENCHMARK_TYPE2} LEFT JOIN OPT_TARGET_INFO opt ON opt.TARGET_ID = fin.BENCHMARK_ID where mst.FINPROD_ID2 = #{finprodId2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and mst.VAL_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{valDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
